## Hendesson Alves

[Geographer · Master's student in Geography at the University of Brasília (UnB)]{.subtitulo}

I study how where people live, and extreme heat, affect their health, using Brazilian public health data (SUS), maps and spatial analysis. I am a research collaborator at the Laboratory of Geography, Environment and Health (LAGAS/UnB).

[GitHub](https://github.com/Hendesson) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hendesson-alves) · [Lattes](http://lattes.cnpq.br/7900166623696256) · [ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Hendesson-Pereira) · [hendesson124@gmail.com](mailto:hendesson124@gmail.com)

#### What I am working on

- [localdatasus](projects/localdatasus/index.qmd): an R package that takes Brazilian health data from the municipality down to the neighborhood.
- [GeoCalor](projects/geocalor/index.qmd): a dashboard on heat waves and health, at LAGAS.
- My master's in Geography at UnB.
